## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  DRRecordSet:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      Name: "app.example.com."
      Type: "A"
      Failover: "PRIMARY"
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - "1.2.3.4"  # placeholder for primary region
```
